patch_description: Building on the Gen35 hierarchical block (RY → alternating ring CRZ → RX → skip-2 CRZ → diameter CRZ), the key insight is that the two-parameter alternating diameter layer added expressivity but also slowed convergence (540 steps) relative to the simpler skip-only variant (150 steps, but worse gap). To get the best of both worlds, this version (1) collapses the diameter layer to a *single* shared parameter (`crz_diam`) instead of two alternating ones, cutting one knob that mainly added training-time variance without much added expressivity, and (2) introduces a new distance-3 ("skip-3") entangling layer with a single shared parameter (`crz_skip3`) to cover the previously-missing connectivity pattern (0-3,1-4,...) at minimal parameter cost. The block (RY, ring-CRZ alternating, RX, skip-2 CRZ, skip-3 CRZ, diameter CRZ) is applied twice with shared parameter names, preserving the proven "shared-depth" regularization trick while giving richer global connectivity (skip-2, skip-3, and diameter cover distances 2, 3, and 4) at a lower total parameter count than Gen35, aiming for a better accuracy/gap/convergence trade-off.
